scope: Contract-driven remainder of #669 and #704: ten wrong-substance synonyms on nine records retyped REJECTED_LABEL (each checked against chebi.db and the owning record); Tricine re-grounded from the structureless class CHEBI:46760 to CHEBI:39063 by its own CAS (44 memberships follow); Na2-citrate split off Trisodium_Citrate as its own cas:144-33-2 record with broadMatch to citric acid and a registry row (3 memberships follow). No approval asserted.
approval: NONE: every touched row is withheld pending mapping-specific review; no prior approval carries across this link.

records.verification: names of other peptone products, each with its own record (Fish_peptone, Meat_peptone)
the acid hydrolysate product has its own record (Casein_hydrolysate, MICRO:0001366)

the free base's name on the dihydrochloride salt (Section 3: salts are not the parent)

the anhydrous salt's label on the hexahydrate record

the monomer's name on the oligosaccharide record

records.change: identifier CHEBI:46760 -> CHEBI:39063; mapping_quality EXACT_MATCH -> CAS_RN_LOOKUP
records.verification: identifier CHEBI:46760 -> CHEBI:39063; ontology 'tricine' -> 'N-tris(hydroxymethyl)methylglycine'; mapping_quality EXACT_MATCH -> CAS_RN_LOOKUP. CHEBI:46760 is a grouping class with a label and nothing else (no formula, InChIKey or definition); its children are the neutral CHEBI:39063, which owns the structure, the systematic names and the xref cas:5704-04-1 (the record's own CAS, on no other term), and the zwitterion CHEBI:46759. Section 3: the most specific stable identifier (#704).
Disodium hydrogen citrate is a different salt; own record minted.

records.change: new record cas:144-33-2 (disodium hydrogen citrate), broadMatch CHEBI:30769; occurrence_statistics 0/0 -> 3/3
records.verification: Na2-citrate is disodium hydrogen citrate (PubChem CID 8950, CAS 144-33-2, C6H6Na2O7, InChIKey CEYULKASIQJZGP-UHFFFAOYSA-L). ChEBI has no disodium citrate term, and three CultureMech recipes name it, so MAPPING_SEMANTICS Section 3 step 2 applies: cas: identity, broadMatch to the acid the label's salt derives from (CHEBI:30769 citric acid), Rule B1 registry row. Previously an EXACT_SYNONYM on Trisodium_Citrate after a 2026-04-19 merge that conflated the two salts (#704).
